Schwannoma: Mammogram finding: well-defined mass measuring 36 mm in its maximum diameter, adjacent to the left nipple
Physical examination finding: 4 × 4 cm firm mass located directly beneath the left breast

top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The presence of a well-defined mass on mammogram, spindle cell morphology, S-100 protein expression, and absence of mitoses are all consistent with a diagnosis of Schwannoma. The duration of symptoms and physical examination findings also support this diagnosis.
